summary: Excellent proxy-aware availability analysis that combines impact, severity, persistence, counterexamples, provider checks, and alternative explanations.

artifactRatings.rationale: Reported signals are internally consistent and the conclusions stay within what completed-trip wait data can support.
Places, times, proxies, evidence, contradictions, recommendations, and limitations are all addressed in depth.
Cleaning, matched city baselines, minimum cells, impact/severity rankings, persistence, provider, on-scene, and cutoff checks are well designed.
Headline claims trace to cell-level metrics and named supporting CSVs with reconciled audit counts.
The report repeatedly distinguishes fulfilled demand and drop-off proxies from latent need and actual fleet supply.

strengths: Counterexamples directly test and reject a simplistic high-demand-equals-shortage interpretation.
Separates airport operations and distinguishes observations from recommendations.
concerns: No external rerun was performed for this artifact-only review.
